title: Dalrymple availability: a more precise missing-method request
summary: A bounded text-only follow-up locates the availability-method request in the contractual guarantee and monthly calculations. Telemetry flags are not an eligible-time denominator. Original observations and the September 14 period amendment remain unchanged; no series is admitted.
evidence_note: Official report text was reviewed; no page image was available for visual inspection. A report-4 request returned a tool error and a local report-1 download was denied by socket permissions. Neither failure establishes document nonexistence. The follow-up preserves exact report dates, locators, access limits and required artifacts separately from the original pilot review.
publication_effect: Local research only; no governed observation, independent admission, publication approval or Phase 60 gate decision. Production and Phase 211 acceptance remain pending.
